dct_description_sm: To enhance knowledge of beluga spring habitat use in the Mackenzie Estuary, Beaufort Sea Shelf area, this Environmental Studies Research Fund (ESRF) project collected recent data on beluga location in relation to sea ice break-up and integrated historical beluga surveys into a digital format for comparisons. The objectives of this project were to: (1) provide an updated dataset on the spring arrival of beluga whales into the Mackenzie Estuary in relation to sea ice, (2) digitize historical surveys so they are available for comparisons with current aerial surveys so changes in beluga arrivals can be assessed as they relate to sea ice break- up and the start of beluga harvest in the region, and (3) involve local Inuvialuit students and community members in the data collection.
dct_title_s: Spring aerial survey observations of beluga whales in the southeast Beaufort Sea (2011-2013)
